4:     allies: &mut [Combatant],
5:     enemies: &mut [Combatant],
6:     round: usize,
7:     random: &mut DeterministicRng,
8:     recorder: &mut BattleRecorder,
9:     parameters: crate::combat::AutoresolveParameters,
10: ) -> BattleResolutionResult<()> {
11:     const TACTICAL_SERVER_STEPS_PER_SECOND: f32 = 64.0;
12:     let step_count = (parameters.combat_round_seconds.seconds() * TACTICAL_SERVER_STEPS_PER_SECOND)
13:         .round()
14:         .max(1.0) as usize;
15:     let window_seconds = AnimationElapsed::from_seconds(
16:         parameters.combat_round_seconds.seconds() / step_count as f32,
17:     )?;
18:     let round_start_seconds = BattleTime::from_seconds(
19:         round.saturating_sub(1) as f32 * parameters.combat_round_seconds.seconds(),
20:     )?;
21:     for step in 0..step_count {

23:             break;

26:             allies,
27:             enemies,
28:             round,
29:             round_start_seconds.checked_add(window_seconds.checked_scale(step as f32)?)?,

43: fn resolve_joint_melee_window(
44:     allies: &mut [Combatant],
45:     enemies: &mut [Combatant],
46:     round: usize,
47:     window_start_seconds: BattleTime,
48:     window_seconds: AnimationElapsed,
49:     random: &mut DeterministicRng,
50:     recorder: &mut BattleRecorder,
51:     parameters: crate::combat::AutoresolveParameters,
52: ) -> BattleResolutionResult<()> {
53:     let window_end_seconds = window_start_seconds.checked_add(window_seconds)?;
54:     let contact_tolerance = AnimationElapsed::from_seconds(1.0e-6)?;
55:     let allies_first = allies
56:         .first()
57:         .zip(enemies.first())
58:         .is_none_or(|(a, e)| a.id <= e.id);
59:     let mut attacks = scheduled_contacts(
60:         allies,
61:         enemies,
62:         window_start_seconds,
63:         window_end_seconds,
64:         parameters,
65:     );
66:     let movement_until_seconds = attacks
67:         .iter()
68:         .map(|(_, attack)| attack.attack_timing.contact_at_seconds)
69:         .min_by(BattleTime::total_cmp)
70:         .unwrap_or(window_end_seconds);
71:     attacks.retain(|(_, attack)| {
72:         attack
73:             .attack_timing
74:             .contact_at_seconds
75:             .is_within(movement_until_seconds, contact_tolerance)
76:     });
77:     advance_joint_melee_movement(
78:         allies,
79:         enemies,
80:         window_start_seconds,
81:         movement_until_seconds.saturating_elapsed_since(window_start_seconds)?,
82:         recorder,
83:         parameters,
84:     )?;
85:     sort_contacts(&mut attacks, allies, enemies);
86:     resolve_contacts(
87:         attacks, allies, enemies, round, random, recorder, parameters,
88:     )?;
89:     if side_defeated(allies) || side_defeated(enemies) {
90:         return Ok(());
91:     }
92:     if movement_until_seconds.precedes_with_margin(window_end_seconds, contact_tolerance) {
93:         resolve_joint_melee_window(
94:             allies,
95:             enemies,
96:             round,
97:             movement_until_seconds,

99:             random,
100:             recorder,
101:             parameters,
102:         )?;
103:         return Ok(());
104:     }
105:     advance_joint_melee_movement(
106:         allies,
107:         enemies,
108:         movement_until_seconds,
109:         window_end_seconds.saturating_elapsed_since(movement_until_seconds)?,
110:         recorder,
111:         parameters,
112:     )?;
113:     schedule_both_sides(
114:         allies,
115:         enemies,
116:         allies_first,
117:         window_end_seconds,
118:         random,
119:         recorder,
120:         parameters,
121:     )?;
122:     Ok(())
123: }

125: fn scheduled_contacts(
126:     allies: &[Combatant],
127:     enemies: &[Combatant],
128:     start: BattleTime,

130:     parameters: crate::combat::AutoresolveParameters,

155: fn sort_contacts(
156:     attacks: &mut [(ScheduledBattleSide, ScheduledMeleeAttack)],
157:     allies: &[Combatant],
158:     enemies: &[Combatant],
159: ) {
160:     attacks.sort_by(|(left_side, left), (right_side, right)| {

163:             .total_cmp(&right.attack_timing.contact_at_seconds)

171:             })
172:     });
173: }

12: 
13: impl RecoveryTime {

18:         }

28: /// The remaining combat effectiveness after all wheel contributions, not a

31:     UnitInterval::from_fraction(1.0 - incapacitation.clamp(0.0, 1.0))
32: }

34: /// Zero recovery needs no performance. Positive recovery is unavailable at zero

36: pub fn incapacitation_adjusted_recovery_seconds(
37:     base_recovery: AnimationElapsed,
38:     performance: UnitInterval,
39: ) -> ElapsedResult<RecoveryTime> {
40:     if base_recovery.is_zero() {

43:     let performance = performance.fraction().clamp(0.0, 1.0);
44:     if performance == 0.0 {

48:     if !seconds.is_finite() {
49:         return Err(ElapsedError::Overflow);
50:     }
51:     Ok(RecoveryTime::After(AnimationElapsed::from_seconds(
52:         seconds,

146: fn plan_property(
147:     property: &CityCompound,
148:     buildings: &std::collections::BTreeMap<
149:         crate::scene_input::SceneBuildingId,
150:         TacticalBuildingPlacement,
151:     >,
152:     recipes: &mut CityRecipePalette,
153:     geographic: &GeographicSurface,
154:     streets: &[CityStreetPatch],
155:     policy: CompoundGradingPolicy,
156: ) -> Result<CompoundSupportPlan, CitySupportError> {
157:     let building = |id| {
158:         buildings.get(&id).ok_or(CitySupportError::MissingBuilding {
159:             property: property.id,
160:             building: id,
161:         })
162:     };
163:     let front_placement = building(property.front_building_id)?;
164:     let (mut front, recipe) = member(
165:         property,
166:         front_placement,
167:         adventuresim_building_generator::Direction::North,
168:         recipes,
169:         geographic,
170:     )?;
171:     let threshold = recipe
172:         .door_point(
173:             front_placement,
174:             adventuresim_building_generator::Direction::South,
175:         )?
176:         .ok_or(CitySupportError::MissingBinding {
177:             property: property.id,
178:             building: front.building_id,
179:             binding: SupportBindingRole::Threshold(
180:                 adventuresim_building_generator::Direction::South,
181:             ),
182:         })?;
183:     front.elevation = sample(property, geographic, threshold)?;
184:     let (rear, _) = member(
185:         property,
186:         building(property.rear_building_id)?,
187:         adventuresim_building_generator::Direction::South,
188:         recipes,
189:         geographic,
190:     )?;
191:     let gate =
192:         crate::scene_coordinates::ScenePlanPoint::try_from(property.boundary.gate.centre_metres)
193:             .map_err(|cause| {
194:                 CitySupportError::Support(SupportDiagnostic::gate_position(property, cause))
195:             })?;
196:     let mut routes = property
197:         .access
198:         .iter()
199:         .filter(|r| r.contains_centreline(gate));
200:     let passage =
201:         routes
202:             .next()
203:             .filter(|_| routes.next().is_none())
204:             .ok_or(CitySupportError::GateBinding {
205:                 property: property.id,
206:                 members: [front.building_id, rear.building_id],
207:                 location: SupportDiagnosticLocation::from_attempt_metres(
208:                     property.boundary.gate.centre_metres,
209:                 ),
210:             })?;
211:     street::select(
212:         property,
213:         CompoundSupportLevels {
214:             front,
215:             rear,
216:             court: sample(property, geographic, property.court.centre())?,
217:             gate: sample(property, geographic, gate)?,
218:             street: sample(property, geographic, passage.start())?,
219:         },
220:         threshold,
221:         geographic,
222:         streets,
223:         policy,
224:     )
225: }
226: 
227: fn member(
228:     property: &CityCompound,
229:     placement: &TacticalBuildingPlacement,
230:     outward: adventuresim_building_generator::Direction,
231:     recipes: &mut CityRecipePalette,
232:     geographic: &GeographicSurface,
233: ) -> Result<(MemberSupport, std::sync::Arc<recipes::Recipe>), CitySupportError> {
234:     let p = &placement.program;
235:     let recipe = recipes.for_program(p)?;
236:     if recipe.program != *p {
237:         return Err(CitySupportError::ProgrammeChanged {
238:             building: placement.id,
239:         });
240:     }
241:     let binding = || CitySupportError::MissingBinding {
242:         property: property.id,
243:         building: placement.id,
244:         binding: SupportBindingRole::Threshold(outward),
245:     };
246:     let contact = recipe
247:         .collision
248:         .ground_floor_contact_bounds()
249:         .map_err(|issue| CitySupportError::InvalidBearing {
250:             property: property.id,
251:             building: placement.id,
252:             issue,
253:         })?
254:         .ok_or_else(binding)?;
255:     let threshold = recipe.door_point(placement, outward)?.ok_or_else(binding)?;
256:     Ok((
257:         MemberSupport {
258:             building_id: placement.id,
259:             contact: CityPlotBounds::new(
260:                 crate::scene_coordinates::ScenePlanPoint::try_from(
261:                     placement.centre_metres.metres()
262:                         + placement.orientation.local_to_world(
263:                             contact.centre()?.metres().xz()
264:                                 - recipe.collision.bounds.centre()?.metres().xz(),
265:                         ),
266:                 )?,
267:                 adventuresim_building_generator::spatial_geometry::PlanDimensions::from_metres(
268:                     contact.plan_half_extents()?.metres() * 2.0,
269:                 )?,
270:                 placement.orientation,
271:             )?,
272:             court_threshold_metres: threshold,
273:             elevation: sample(property, geographic, threshold)?,
274:         },
275:         recipe,
276:     ))
277: }

279: fn sample(

290:         })

13: /// One presented vertex and its east/north finite-difference edges. Consumers
14: /// retain their normalization policy when producing a support or mesh normal.
15: pub struct VistaVertexGeometry {
16:     elevation: SupportElevation,
17:     east_tangent: Displacement<Scene>,
18:     north_tangent: Displacement<Scene>,
19: }
20: 
21: impl VistaVertexGeometry {
22:     pub fn sample(
23:         lod: &VistaLod,
24:         coarser: Option<&VistaLod>,
25:         terrain: Option<&SceneTerrain>,
26:         local: PlanDisplacement,
27:         playable_half_extent: Vec2,
28:         normal_sample_distance: PositiveLength,
29:     ) -> Option<Self> {
30:         let height = native_presented_vista_vertex_height(
31:             lod,
32:             coarser,
33:             terrain,
34:             local,
35:             playable_half_extent,
36:         )?;
37:         let delta = normal_sample_distance.metres();
38:         let at = |offset: Vec2| {
39:             PlanDisplacement::from_metres(local.metres() + offset)
40:                 .and_then(|probe| {
41:                     native_presented_vista_vertex_height(
42:                         lod,
43:                         coarser,
44:                         terrain,
45:                         probe,
46:                         playable_half_extent,
47:                     )
48:                 })
49:                 .unwrap_or(height)
50:         };
51:         Some(Self {
52:             elevation: SupportElevation::from_metres(height)?,
53:             east_tangent: Displacement::from_metres(Vec3::new(
54:                 delta * 2.0,
55:                 at(Vec2::X * delta) - at(-Vec2::X * delta),
56:                 0.0,
57:             ))
58:             .ok()?,
59:             north_tangent: Displacement::from_metres(Vec3::new(
60:                 0.0,
61:                 at(Vec2::Y * delta) - at(-Vec2::Y * delta),
62:                 delta * 2.0,
63:             ))
64:             .ok()?,
65:         })
66:     }

69:         self.elevation
70:     }

73:         self.east_tangent
74:     }

77:         self.north_tangent
78:     }

82:     /// Structural admission for the native row-major height interpolation.
83:     /// Environmental columns have their separate mesh/pigment admission.
84:     pub fn has_height_grid(&self) -> bool {
85:         self.width >= 2
86:             && self.depth >= 2
87:             && self.heights_metres.len() == usize::from(self.width) * usize::from(self.depth)
88:             && self.spacing_metres.is_finite()
89:             && self.spacing_metres > 0.0
90:             && (self.origin_east_metres as f32).is_finite()
91:             && (self.origin_north_metres as f32).is_finite()
92:     }

101:         )

1: // Shader ABI of the chunk-instanced renderer (`chunk_instancing.rs`).
2: //
3: // Every instanced material draws one mesh many times per chunk entity. Mesh
4: // attributes keep Bevy's locations; the per-instance stream follows at 8-10.
5: // Instances are already in world space, so the chunk entity's transform only
6: // steers Bevy's CPU culling and never reaches the shader.
7: #define_import_path fablegeist::chunk_instancing
8: 
9: #import bevy_pbr::mesh_view_bindings::view
10: 
11: struct Vertex {
12:     @location(0) position: vec3<f32>,
13: #ifdef VERTEX_NORMALS
14:     @location(1) normal: vec3<f32>,
15: #endif
16: #ifdef VERTEX_UVS_A
17:     @location(2) uv: vec2<f32>,
18: #endif
19: #ifdef VERTEX_UVS_B
20:     @location(3) uv_b: vec2<f32>,
21: #endif
22: #ifdef VERTEX_TANGENTS
23:     @location(4) tangent: vec4<f32>,
24: #endif
25: #ifdef VERTEX_COLORS
26:     @location(5) color: vec4<f32>,
27: #endif
28:     // World position (xyz) and uniform scale (w).
29:     @location(8) i_pos_scale: vec4<f32>,
30:     // Yaw about +Y, radians.
31:     @location(9) i_rotation: f32,
32:     // Content-defined bits; grass keeps placement coverage in the low byte.
33:     @location(10) i_seed: u32,
34: };
35: 
36: // The distance band a chunk's instances draw in: `xy` fade-in and `zw`
37: // fade-out, metres from the camera.
38: struct ChunkBand {
39:     visibility_range: vec4<f32>,
40: };
41: 
42: @group(2) @binding(0) var<uniform> chunk_band: ChunkBand;
43: 
44: fn instance_world_matrix(i_pos_scale: vec4<f32>, i_rotation: f32) -> mat4x4<f32> {
45:     let scale = i_pos_scale.w;
46:     let c = cos(i_rotation) * scale;
47:     let s = sin(i_rotation) * scale;
48:     return mat4x4<f32>(
49:         vec4<f32>(c, 0.0, -s, 0.0),
50:         vec4<f32>(0.0, scale, 0.0, 0.0),
51:         vec4<f32>(s, 0.0, c, 0.0),
52:         vec4<f32>(i_pos_scale.xyz, 1.0),
53:     );
54: }
55: 
56: // Bevy's visibility-range dither level for one instance, adapted from
57: // `bevy_pbr::mesh_functions`:
58: //
59: //     `lod_range.`          x        y        z        w           camera distance
60: //                   ←───────┼────────┼────────┼────────┼────────→
61: //     Dither Level  -16    -16       0        0        16      16  Dither Level
62: fn visibility_range_dither_level(lod_range: vec4<f32>, world_position: vec3<f32>) -> i32 {
63:     let camera_distance = length(view.world_position.xyz - world_position);
64:     let offset = select(-16, 0, camera_distance >= lod_range.z);
65:     let bounds = select(lod_range.xy, lod_range.zw, camera_distance >= lod_range.z);
66:     let level = i32(round((camera_distance - bounds.x) / (bounds.y - bounds.x) * 16.));
67:     return offset + clamp(level, 0, 16);
68: }

3: 
4: use adventuresim_tactical_core::prelude::*;

15: #[derive(SystemParam)]
16: pub(super) struct WorldGrabTargets<'w, 's> {
17:     cameras: Query<'w, 's, &'static GlobalTransform, With<TacticalGameplayCamera>>,
18:     scene_items: Query<
19:         'w,
20:         's,
21:         (
22:             Entity,
23:             &'static GlobalTransform,
24:             &'static TacticalEquipmentPhysical,
25:         ),
26:         With<TacticalSceneItem>,
27:     >,
28:     doors: Query<'w, 's, (Entity, &'static GlobalTransform, &'static SceneDoor)>,
29:     windows: Query<'w, 's, (Entity, &'static GlobalTransform, &'static SceneWindow)>,
30:     spatial: SpatialQuery<'w, 's>,
31: }
32: 
33: impl WorldGrabTargets<'_, '_> {
34:     pub(super) fn pointed(&self, actor: &GlobalTransform) -> Option<GrabSelection> {
35:         let camera = self.cameras.single().ok()?;
36:         let origin = actor.translation() + Vec3::Y * 0.6;
37:         auto_aim_candidate(
38:             camera.translation(),
39:             camera.forward().as_vec3(),
40:             actor.translation(),
41:             PICKUP_RANGE_M,
42:             self.scene_items
43:                 .iter()
44:                 .filter_map(|(entity, transform, physical)| {
45:                     let position = transform.transform_point(-physical.anchor_offset_m);
46:                     self.visible(origin, position).then_some((
47:                         GrabSelection::SceneItem(entity),
48:                         position,
49:                         entity.to_bits(),
50:                     ))
51:                 })
52:                 .chain(self.doors.iter().filter_map(|(entity, transform, door)| {
53:                     can_grab_door_from_inside(
54:                         actor.translation(),
55:                         door.doorway_centre_metres.metres(),
56:                         door.tangent.vector(),
57:                         door.outward.vector(),
58:                         door.size_metres.metres().x * 0.5,
59:                     )
60:                     .then(|| transform.translation())
61:                     .filter(|position| self.visible(origin, *position))
62:                     .map(|position| (GrabSelection::Door(entity), position, entity.to_bits()))
63:                 }))
64:                 .chain(
65:                     self.windows
66:                         .iter()
67:                         .filter_map(|(entity, transform, window)| {
68:                             can_grab_window_from_inside(
69:                                 actor.translation(),
70:                                 window.opening_centre_metres.metres(),
71:                                 window.tangent.vector(),
72:                                 window.outward.vector(),
73:                                 window.size_metres.metres().x * 0.5,
74:                             )
75:                             .then(|| transform.translation())
76:                             .filter(|position| self.visible(origin, *position))
77:                             .map(|position| {
78:                                 (GrabSelection::Window(entity), position, entity.to_bits())
79:                             })
80:                         }),
81:                 ),
82:         )
83:     }

85:     fn visible(&self, origin: Vec3, position: Vec3) -> bool {
86:         let sight = position - origin;
87:         let distance = sight.length();
88:         distance > 0.0
89:             && Dir3::new(sight / distance).is_ok_and(|direction| {
90:                 self.spatial
91:                     .cast_ray(
92:                         origin,
93:                         direction,
94:                         distance,
95:                         true,
96:                         &SpatialQueryFilter::from_mask(TACTICAL_TERRAIN_LAYER),
97:                     )

1: //! Browser transport for the authoritative weapon recipe library.
2: //!
3: //! Requests use the library's recipe schema. Geometry, anchors, validation,
4: //! material masses and physical properties come directly from that library;
5: //! this boundary owns no construction or physical calculation.
6: 
7: use adventuresim_weapon_model::{
8:     GENERATOR_VERSION, MELEE_CATALOG_IDS, PRESET_IDS, SCHEMA_VERSION, WeaponDesign,
9:     WeaponHolderDesign, default_design, derive_material_masses, encode, generate, generate_holder,
10:     numeric_editor_fields, preset_design,
11: };
12: use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
13: 
14: #[derive(Deserialize)]
15: #[serde(tag = "operation", rename_all = "kebab-case", deny_unknown_fields)]
16: enum Request {
17:     Model {
18:         recipe: adventuresim_weapon_model::recipe::Recipe,
19:         detail: adventuresim_weapon_model::Detail,
20:     },
21:     Catalog {},
22:     AuthoringCatalog {},
23:     MuseumStudies {},
24:     ValidateModel {
25:         recipe: adventuresim_weapon_model::recipe::Recipe,
26:         controls: Vec<serde_json::Value>,
27:         detail: adventuresim_weapon_model::Detail,
28:     },
29:     Compose {
30:         haft: String,
31:         head: String,
32:     },
33:     CompositionControls {
34:         recipe: adventuresim_weapon_model::recipe::Recipe,
35:     },
36:     Preset {
37:         id: String,
38:     },
39:     GameplayDesign {
40:         id: String,
41:     },
42:     Generate {
43:         design: WeaponDesign,
44:     },
45:     GenerateHolder {
46:         design: WeaponHolderDesign,
47:     },
48:     EditorFields {
49:         design: WeaponDesign,
50:     },
51: }
52: 
53: #[derive(Serialize)]
54: struct Catalog {
55:     schema_version: u16,
56:     generator_version: u16,
57:     presets: &'static [&'static str],
58:     gameplay: &'static [&'static str],
59: }
60: 
61: #[derive(Debug, thiserror::Error)]
62: enum RequestError {
63:     #[error("invalid construction: {0}")]
64:     Construction(String),
65:     #[error("invalid request: {0}")]
66:     Json(#[from] serde_json::Error),
67:     #[error("unknown weapon preset: {0}")]
68:     UnknownPreset(String),
69:     #[error("unknown gameplay weapon: {0}")]
70:     UnknownGameplayDesign(String),
71:     #[error("invalid weapon: {0}")]
72:     Generation(#[from] adventuresim_weapon_model::GenerateError),

76:     Materials(Vec<adventuresim_weapon_model::ValidationError>),
77: }
78: 
79: impl Request {
80:     fn execute(self) -> Result<String, RequestError> {
81:         let value = match self {
82:             Self::Model { recipe, detail } => serde_json::to_value(

84:                     .map_err(RequestError::Construction)?,
85:             )?,
86:             Self::ValidateModel {
87:                 recipe,
88:                 controls,
89:                 detail,
90:             } => {
91:                 adventuresim_weapon_model::authoring::validate_controls(&recipe, &controls)
92:                     .map_err(RequestError::Construction)?;

94:                     adventuresim_weapon_model::generate_model(&recipe, detail)
95:                         .map_err(RequestError::Construction)?,
96:                 )?
97:             }
98:             Self::MuseumStudies {} => {
99:                 adventuresim_weapon_model::authoring::museum_studies().clone()
100:             }

1: //! Evaluate guard node bindings in dependency order in component coordinates.
2: use super::*;
3: use std::collections::BTreeMap;
4: pub(super) fn resolve(
5:     p: &mut GuardAssemblyParameters,
6:     frames: &BTreeMap<String, Point>,
7:     offset: Point,
8:     rotation: Point,
9: ) -> Result<(), String> {
10:     let order = p.binding_order()?;
11:     let Some(bindings) = &p.node_bindings else {
12:         return Ok(());
13:     };
14:     for name in order {
15:         if !p.nodes.contains_key(&name) {
16:             return Err("binding references missing guard node".into());
17:         }
18:         let point = match &bindings[&name] {
19:             NodeBinding::Frame {
20:                 frame,
21:                 offset: delta,
22:             } => {
23:                 let target = *frames
24:                     .get(frame)
25:                     .ok_or_else(|| format!("missing bound node frame {frame}"))?;
26:                 add(
27:                     inverse_rotate(sub(target, offset), rotation),
28:                     delta.map_or([0.0; 3], |p| p.map(Metres::get)),
29:                 )
30:             }
31:             NodeBinding::Between {
32:                 between,
33:                 t,
34:                 offset: delta,
35:             } => {
36:                 let a = p
37:                     .nodes
38:                     .get(&between[0])
39:                     .ok_or("missing interpolation node")?
40:                     .map(Metres::get);
41:                 let b = p
42:                     .nodes
43:                     .get(&between[1])
44:                     .ok_or("missing interpolation node")?
45:                     .map(Metres::get);
46:                 add(
47:                     lerp(a, b, t.map_or(0.5, Ratio::get)),
48:                     delta.map_or([0.0; 3], |p| p.map(Metres::get)),
49:                 )
50:             }
51:         };
52:         p.nodes.insert(
53:             name,
54:             [
55:                 Metres::new(point[0])?,
56:                 Metres::new(point[1])?,
57:                 Metres::new(point[2])?,
58:             ],
59:         );
60:     }
61:     Ok(())
62: }

721:                 .saturating_sub(combatant.equipment.ammunition)
722:         })
723:         .sum();
724: 
725:     Ok(BattleOutcome {
726:         seed,
727:         resolution,
728:         rounds,
729:         allies: allies.into_iter().map(outcome).collect(),
730:         enemies: enemies.into_iter().map(outcome).collect(),
731:         summary: recorder.summary,
732:         log: recorder.log,
733:         timeline: recorder.timeline,
734:     })
735: }
736: 
737: fn classify_battle_resolution(
738:     allies_defeated: bool,
739:     enemies_defeated: bool,
740:     round_limit_reached: bool,
741: ) -> Option<BattleResolution> {
742:     match (allies_defeated, enemies_defeated) {
743:         (true, true) => Some(BattleResolution::MutualIncapacitation),
744:         (true, false) => Some(BattleResolution::EnemiesVictory),
745:         (false, true) => Some(BattleResolution::AlliesVictory),
746:         (false, false) if round_limit_reached => Some(BattleResolution::Timeout),
747:         (false, false) => None,
748:     }

43: fn resolve_joint_melee_window(
44:     allies: &mut [Combatant],
45:     enemies: &mut [Combatant],
46:     round: usize,
47:     window_start_seconds: BattleTime,
48:     window_seconds: AnimationElapsed,
49:     random: &mut DeterministicRng,
50:     recorder: &mut BattleRecorder,
51:     parameters: crate::combat::AutoresolveParameters,
52: ) -> BattleResolutionResult<()> {
53:     let window_end_seconds = window_start_seconds.checked_add(window_seconds)?;
54:     let contact_tolerance = AnimationElapsed::from_seconds(1.0e-6)?;
55:     let allies_first = allies
56:         .first()
57:         .zip(enemies.first())
58:         .is_none_or(|(a, e)| a.id <= e.id);
59:     let mut attacks = scheduled_contacts(
60:         allies,
61:         enemies,
62:         window_start_seconds,
63:         window_end_seconds,
64:         parameters,
65:     );
66:     let movement_until_seconds = attacks
67:         .iter()
68:         .map(|(_, attack)| attack.attack_timing.contact_at_seconds)
69:         .min_by(BattleTime::total_cmp)
70:         .unwrap_or(window_end_seconds);
71:     attacks.retain(|(_, attack)| {
72:         attack
73:             .attack_timing
74:             .contact_at_seconds
75:             .is_within(movement_until_seconds, contact_tolerance)
76:     });
77:     advance_joint_melee_movement(
78:         allies,
79:         enemies,
80:         window_start_seconds,
81:         movement_until_seconds.saturating_elapsed_since(window_start_seconds)?,
82:         recorder,
83:         parameters,
84:     )?;

86:     resolve_contacts(
87:         attacks, allies, enemies, round, random, recorder, parameters,
88:     )?;
89:     if side_defeated(allies) || side_defeated(enemies) {
90:         return Ok(());
91:     }

93:         resolve_joint_melee_window(

95:             enemies,
96:             round,
97:             movement_until_seconds,
98:             window_end_seconds.elapsed_since(movement_until_seconds)?,
99:             random,
100:             recorder,
101:             parameters,
102:         )?;
103:         return Ok(());
104:     }

106:         allies,
107:         enemies,
108:         movement_until_seconds,

15: /// pulled in from `TimePlugin`) and `aeronet_io::Session` (a component on
16: /// every connected client's entity) hit exactly this - each contains a
17: /// `bevy_platform::time::Instant` with no `ReflectSerialize` registered.
18: /// Neither is reachable from a bare `App::new()` (what this file's own
19: /// tests use), which is why this took two rounds to actually surface.
20: pub(super) fn on_debug_dump_world_request(
21:     _request: On<FromClient<DebugDumpWorldRequest>>,
22:     world: &World,
23: ) {
24:     let entities: Vec<Entity> = world
25:         .archetypes()
26:         .iter()
27:         .flat_map(|archetype| archetype.entities().iter().map(|entity| entity.id()))
28:         .collect();
29:     let registry = world.resource::<AppTypeRegistry>().read();
30:     // The filter must be set up *before* `extract_entities` - it's applied
31:     // immediately as entities are extracted, not lazily at `build()`.
32:     let scene = DynamicWorldBuilder::from_world(world, &registry)
33:         .deny_all_components()
34:         .allow_component::<Player>()
35:         .allow_component::<CharacterId>()
36:         .allow_component::<Skills>()
37:         .allow_component::<Limbs>()
38:         .allow_component::<TacticalAttributes>()
39:         .allow_component::<Stats>()
40:         .allow_component::<TacticalCombatState>()
41:         .allow_component::<TacticalCombatSide>()
42:         .allow_component::<Transform>()
43:         .allow_component::<SceneId>()
44:         .allow_component::<SceneTerrain>()
45:         .allow_component::<SceneBuilding>()
46:         .allow_component::<SceneBoundary>()
47:         .allow_component::<SceneGarden>()
48:         .allow_component::<SceneFurniture>()
49:         .allow_component::<SceneFurnitureGroup>()
50:         .allow_component::<SceneVistaFurniture>()
51:         .allow_component::<crate::bot::MissionEnemy>()
52:         .allow_component::<crate::bot::OffensiveCombatAi>()
53:         .allow_component::<crate::bot::CombatantBehaviorPackages>()
54:         .allow_component::<crate::bot::ReactiveDefenseAi>()
55:         .allow_component::<crate::bot::DefenseChances>()
56:         .allow_component::<crate::bot::RaisedGuardAi>()
57:         .allow_component::<crate::bot::AimAtNearestOpponentAi>()
58:         .allow_component::<crate::bot::RecoverToUprightAi>()
59:         // Inventory items are separate entities (linked back to their
60:         // owning character via `ItemOf`), not components on the character
61:         // itself - without these, a dumped/loaded character's equipment is
62:         // silently empty. `InventoryItems` (the reverse side of the
63:         // `ItemOf` relationship) MUST be captured too: scene loading
64:         // applies components with `RelationshipHookMode::Skip`, so nothing
65:         // reconstructs the reverse side on load - a dump carries both sides
66:         // of the relationship verbatim, exactly like bevy's own
67:         // `ChildOf`/`Children` pair in dynamic scenes.
68:         .allow_component::<InventoryItems>()
69:         .allow_component::<ItemOf>()
70:         .allow_component::<TacticalItemQuantity>()
71:         .allow_component::<ItemProperties>()
72:         .allow_component::<WeaponItem>()
73:         .allow_component::<ShieldItem>()
74:         .allow_component::<ArmorItem>()
75:         .allow_component::<EquipmentTopology>()
76:         .allow_component::<EquipSlot>()
77:         .extract_entities(entities.into_iter())
78:         .build();
79:     let ron = match scene.serialize(&registry) {
80:         Ok(ron) => ron,
81:         Err(error) => {
82:             error!(?error, "Failed to serialize world dump");
83:             return;
84:         }
85:     };
86:     drop(registry);
87: 
88:     let dir = std::path::Path::new("world_dumps");
89:     if let Err(error) = std::fs::create_dir_all(dir) {
90:         error!(?error, "Failed to create world_dumps directory");
91:         return;
92:     }
93:     let timestamp = std::time::SystemTime::now()
94:         .duration_since(std::time::UNIX_EPOCH)
95:         .unwrap_or_default()
96:         .as_millis();
97:     let path = dir.join(format!("world_dump_{timestamp}.scn.ron"));
98:     match std::fs::write(&path, ron) {
99:         Ok(()) => info!(path = %path.display(), "Dumped world state"),
100:         Err(error) => error!(?error, path = %path.display(), "Failed to write world dump"),
101:     }
102: }

11: impl ConditionTrend {
12:     pub(super) fn update(
13:         &mut self,
14:         current: TacticalIncapacitationSources,
15:         elapsed: AnimationElapsed,
16:         config: IncapacitationForecastConfig,
17:     ) -> TacticalIncapacitationSources {
18:         if elapsed.is_zero() {
19:             return TacticalIncapacitationSources::default();
20:         }
21:         let Some(previous) = self.previous.replace(current) else {
22:             return TacticalIncapacitationSources::default();
23:         };
24:         let blend = -(-elapsed.seconds() / config.trend_response_seconds.seconds()).exp_m1();
25:         let mut forecast = TacticalIncapacitationSources::default();
26:         macro_rules! source {
27:             ($field:ident) => {
28:                 self.rates.$field += ((current.$field - previous.$field) / elapsed.seconds()
29:                     - self.rates.$field)
30:                     * blend;
31:                 forecast.$field = (self.rates.$field * config.horizon_seconds.seconds()).max(0.0);
32:             };
33:         }
34:         source!(pain);
35:         source!(acute_trauma);
36:         source!(blood_loss);
37:         source!(fear);
38:         source!(fatigue);
39:         source!(hunger);
40:         source!(thirst);
41:         source!(thermal);
42:         source!(imbalance);
43:         source!(encumbrance);
44:         forecast
45:     }
46: }

519:     skills: &mut CharacterSkills,

521:     real_hours: f32,
522:     attributes: &CharacterAttributes,
523: ) -> Result<adventuresim_core::book::BoundedBookGain, String> {
524:     use adventuresim_core::item_catalog_schema::BookTarget;
525:     let medium_rank = adventuresim_core::book::written_rank(
526:         skills.written_languages.effective(book.medium),
527:         attributes.intelligence,
528:     );
529:     let (rank, aptitude) = target_snapshot(skills, &book.target, attributes)
530:         .ok_or("Book catalog contains an unsupported training target")?;
531:     let (lower, upper) = adventuresim_core::book::rank_band(book);
532:     match &book.target {
533:         BookTarget::Written { language } => {
534:             Ok(adventuresim_core::book::apply_written_book_training(
535:                 &mut skills.written_languages,
536:                 book.medium,
537:                 *language,
538:                 rank,
539:                 attributes.intelligence,
540:                 lower,
541:                 upper,
542:                 real_hours,
543:             ))
544:         }
545:         BookTarget::Religion { religion } => {
546:             let baseline = skills.religion_hours;
547:             let direct = skills.religion_hours.direct_mut(*religion);
548:             Ok(adventuresim_core::book::apply_bounded_book_training(
549:                 direct,
550:                 rank,
551:                 aptitude,
552:                 lower,
553:                 upper,
554:                 real_hours,
555:                 medium_rank,
556:                 |rank| Skill::Religion.hours_for_rank(rank),
557:                 |candidate| {
558:                     let mut projected = baseline;
559:                     *projected.direct_mut(*religion) = candidate;
560:                     projected.effective(*religion)
561:                 },
562:             ))
563:         }
564:         BookTarget::Bestiary { category } => {
565:             let baseline = skills.bestiary_hours;
566:             let direct = skills.bestiary_hours.direct_mut(*category);
567:             Ok(adventuresim_core::book::apply_bounded_book_training(
568:                 direct,
569:                 rank,
570:                 aptitude,
571:                 lower,
572:                 upper,
573:                 real_hours,
574:                 medium_rank,
575:                 |rank| Skill::Bestiary.hours_for_rank(rank),
576:                 |candidate| {
577:                     let mut projected = baseline;
578:                     *projected.direct_mut(*category) = candidate;
579:                     projected.effective(*category)
580:                 },
581:             ))
582:         }

584:             let skill = terrain_book_skill(terrain)
585:                 .ok_or("Book catalog contains an unsupported terrain target")?;
586:             let transferred = skill

588:                 .iter()
589:                 .map(|(source, coefficient)| {
590:                     skills.skill_hours_trained(*source).max(0.0) * coefficient
591:                 })
592:                 .sum::<f32>()
593:                 .max(0.0);
594:             Ok(adventuresim_core::book::apply_bounded_book_training(
595:                 direct_skill_hours_mut(skills, skill),
596:                 rank,
597:                 aptitude,
598:                 lower,
599:                 upper,
600:                 real_hours,
601:                 medium_rank,
602:                 |rank| skill.hours_for_rank(rank),
603:                 |candidate| candidate.max(0.0) + transferred,
604:             ))
605:         }
606:         BookTarget::Skill { .. } => {
607:             let skill = adventuresim_core::book::ordinary_skill(&book.target)
608:                 .ok_or("Book catalog contains an unsupported skill target")?;
609:             let transferred = skill
610:                 .ordinary_correlations()
611:                 .iter()
612:                 .map(|(source, coefficient)| {
613:                     skills.skill_hours_trained(*source).max(0.0) * coefficient
614:                 })
615:                 .sum::<f32>()
616:                 .max(0.0);
617:             Ok(adventuresim_core::book::apply_bounded_book_training(
618:                 direct_skill_hours_mut(skills, skill),
619:                 rank,
620:                 aptitude,
621:                 lower,
622:                 upper,
623:                 real_hours,
624:                 medium_rank,
625:                 |rank| skill.hours_for_rank(rank),
626:                 |candidate| {
627:                     let candidate = candidate.max(0.0);
628:                     if skill.is_trained() && candidate <= 0.0 {
629:                         0.0
630:                     } else if skill.is_trained() {
631:                         candidate + transferred.min(candidate)
632:                     } else {
633:                         candidate + transferred
634:                     }
635:                 },
636:             ))
637:         }
638:     }
639: }

459: /// A reducer is a function with read/write access to the database

462: /// Each reducer call runs in its own database transaction,
463: /// and its updates to the database are only committed if the reducer returns successfully.
464: ///
465: /// The first argument of a reducer is always a [`&ReducerContext`]. This context object
466: /// allows accessing the database and viewing information about the caller, among other things.
467: ///
468: /// After this, a reducer can take any number of arguments.
469: /// These arguments must implement the [`SpacetimeType`], [`Serialize`], and [`Deserialize`] traits.
470: /// All of these traits can be derived at once by marking a type with `#[derive(SpacetimeType)]`.
471: ///
